title: Entity-level news sentiment falsification contract
hypotheses: Article-level single sentiment can mislabel multi-entity news with conflicting entity impacts.
Sentiment effect may be conditional on novelty/unusualness rather than an independent directional factor.
Volume/volatility response around news may partly reflect investor disagreement rather than sentiment alpha.
supportingEvidence: SEntFiN-style entity-level financial-news datasets motivate target-entity sentiment rather than one label per article.
Glasserman-Mamaysky unusual-news evidence shows sentiment interacts with unusualness in forecasting volatility.
Li-Luan news-based disagreement evidence shows disagreement contains return information after controls for news heterogeneity and volume/volatility channels.
falsificationAndAlternativeExplanations: Accurate text classification does not imply incremental Taiwan stock-selection alpha.
Novelty, disagreement, direct exposure, expectation surprise, sector state, price/volume, volatility and liquidity can absorb apparent sentiment effects.
English financial-news evidence cannot be assumed valid for Traditional Chinese Taiwan news.
Republished or updated articles must not restart an economic-event clock unless new economic information is present.

pitRules.availabilityRule: Never backdate strategy availability to source publication time without authenticated prospective first-observation evidence.
pitRules.versionRule: Append versions; never overwrite early text with later corrected/expanded text.
pitRules.missingRule: Missing source/text/entity/version evidence is UNKNOWN, never zero/BAD.

preregisteredMeasurement.annotation: Traditional-Chinese Taiwan target-entity double-blind human benchmark before any outcome join.

promotionGate: Traditional-Chinese entity-level annotation reliability established without return labels
OOS and walk-forward incremental tests pass
multiple-testing, overfit, date/event clustering, costs and regime dependence pass
incremental value remains after redundancy controls

maturityDecision.reason: Mechanism and falsification contract strengthened, but licensed Taiwan general-news text, prospective PIT cohort and OOS incremental evidence remain absent.

exactNextContinuationPoint: Persist this contract, then stop adding sentiment theory. Validate licensed Traditional-Chinese general-news text scope; build target-entity double-blind annotation benchmark with outcomes closed; only after measurement reliability build prospective PIT event clusters and preregister OOS/walk-forward incremental tests versus novelty, disagreement and existing D17 controls.
